sky.qualification: Himalia's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Jupiter-system ephemeris. Illustrative display pole aligned to the fitted orbital normal, with an arbitrary meridian. This is not a measured spin axis, synchronous rotation, or a current landmark phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Himalia Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
